mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo_attachments (todo_id, original_filename, stored_filename, content_type, file_size, uploaded_at) VALUES (#{todoId}, #{originalFilename}, #{storedFilename}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{uploadedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM todo_attachments WHERE todo_id = #{todoId} ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT a.* FROM todo_attachments a JOIN todos t ON t.id = a.todo_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId}
